title: What a fraction is
examples: Teacher, if I cut a pizza into eight slices, how do I write that as a fraction?
What does the bottom number of a fraction tell me?
Can you show me a unit fraction with circles?

explain.say: Today we are learning about fractions. A fraction is just a way to show parts of a whole thing. Imagine a whole chocolate bar that you share with friends.
If we take one whole pizza and cut it into four equal pieces. Each piece is one part of the whole pizza. We must make sure all the parts are the same size.
The bottom number tells us how many equal parts the whole is split into. This number is called the denominator. It names the total number of pieces.
The top number tells us how many of those parts we are looking at. This number is called the numerator. It counts the parts we have.
If we shade one part out of four equal parts. We write this as one over four. This is a unit fraction because the top number is one.

faq.a: A unit fraction is any fraction where the top number, the numerator, is one. It means you are only counting one single part.
asks: What does it mean to have one over something?

faq.q: Does the whole have to be a shape?
faq.a: No, the whole can be anything that can be divided equally. It could be a group of items or a measurement of time.
asks: Can I use people to show a fraction?
Does the whole have to be visible?

faq.q: Why do I need both a top and a bottom number?
faq.a: We need both numbers to know exactly what we are talking about. The bottom number tells us the total, and the top number tells us the count.
asks: Why can't I just use one number?
What does the denominator tell me?

faq.q: If I shade three parts out of eight, what is the fraction?
faq.a: You have three parts, so the top number is three. The whole is split into eight parts, so the bottom number is eight. The fraction is three over eight.
asks: How do I write 3 out of 8?
If I shade 3 parts, what number goes on top?

faq.q: Can I use fractions for things that are not cut?
faq.a: Yes, you can use fractions for parts of a group. For example, three out of five students wearing blue shirts.
asks: Can I count people for fractions?
Does it have to be cut into pieces?

facts: A fraction represents a part of a whole or a collection.
The denominator shows the total number of equal parts the whole is divided into.
The numerator shows how many of those equal parts are being counted.
A unit fraction always has a numerator of one.

quiz.say: If a cake is cut into six equal pieces and you eat two, what fraction did you eat?
quiz.why: The whole cake has six equal parts, so six is the bottom number. You ate two parts, so two is the top number.

wrong.1: This reverses the numbers, making it look like the whole was only two parts.
wrong.2: This only tells us how many pieces you ate, but not what the whole was.
wrong.3: This only tells us the total number of parts, forgetting how many were eaten.

quiz.say: What is the denominator if a rectangle is divided into ten equal sections?
quiz.why: The denominator tells us the total number of equal parts the whole was split into, which is ten.

wrong.0: One is only used if you are talking about a unit fraction.
wrong.1: This is a fraction, but it does not answer what the denominator is.
wrong.2: Zero means nothing, and the rectangle clearly has parts.

quiz.say: Which fraction represents one part out of five equal parts?
quiz.why: A unit fraction always has one on top, and five is the total number of parts on the bottom.

wrong.0: This means there are five parts and only one total part, which is impossible.
wrong.1: One is a whole number, not a fraction showing a part.
wrong.2: This is the total count, but the question asks for the fraction.
